texts:
Monday's injury news, team by team, with the MRI results and coach updates from around the league.

Deebo Samuel Sr. misses a few weeks.

David Montgomery is week to week.

Will Shipley has a partial plantar fascia tear.
#FTTB #HTownMade #FlyEaglesFly

Deebo Samuel Sr. had an MRI on the hamstring, and Kyle Shanahan says he will miss some time. Ian Rapoport reports a few weeks. WR39 rest of season for me; hold him on your bench.

Mike Evans is WR26 rest of season for me and San Francisco's top outside receiver now.
#FTTB

DeMeco Ryans called David Montgomery week to week with the groin. RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps at TEN and had every backfield touch after that. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.
#HTownMade #TitanUp

Arizona traded Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston for a 2027 second-round pick. WR43 rest of season for me; hold him through his first two Houston games.

Michael Wilson keeps Arizona's outside targets. WR40 rest of season for me; hold him.
#HTownMade #BirdGang

Will Shipley has a partial tear of the plantar fascia and could miss multiple weeks, per Adam Schefter. RB56 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.
#FlyEaglesFly

Nick Sirianni is hopeful Saquon Barkley plays Week 6 vs CAR. RB9 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Dameon Pierce is the healthy early-down back. Stash him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent, only if Barkley sits again.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

DeVonta Smith has missed two games with the hamstring, and Nick Sirianni is hopeful he is back for Week 6. WR12 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#FlyEaglesFly

TreVeyon Henderson had tests on the ankle Monday, and Ian Rapoport reports it is not expected to be long term. RB26 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Rhamondre Stevenson is RB24 rest of season for me; hold him.
#NEPats

Mike Vrabel said A.J. Brown may return to practice this week. WR24 rest of season for me. Monitor; his practice window opening this week.

Drake Maye threw for 374 and 4 TDs Sunday. QB11 rest of season for me; monitor Will Campbell's knee MRI.
#NEPats

Todd Monken called Quinshon Judkins day to day with an ankle tweak, and he is not ruled out for Week 6 vs BAL. RB20 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

Jesse Minter says Lamar Jackson is definitely doing better with the ankle. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Tyler Huntley is QB43 rest of season for me; leave him on waivers in one-QB leagues.
#RavensFlock

Adam Schefter reports Michael Penix Jr.'s rib injury is not serious, and Kevin Stefanski says Atlanta knows more Wednesday. QB23 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#DirtyBirds

Caleb Williams looks on track to return from the hamstring for Week 6 vs ATL. QB10 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Mike McCarthy ruled Roman Wilson (finger) out for Week 6 vs TB, and Jeremy Fowler reports multiple weeks. Drop him for any add.

Germie Bernard caught 6 for 80 Sunday. WR84 rest of season for me. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Mike Macdonald says Zach Charbonnet (knee) is not expected to play Thursday vs DEN. RB47 rest of season for me. Monitor; his first full practice.

Emanuel Wilson ran 20 times for 61 and a TD Sunday. RB59 rest of season for me; hold him for Thursday.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

Kenyon Sadiq is still in the concussion protocol. TE19 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

T.J. Hockenson (concussion) has the Week 6 bye to clear the protocol. TE21 rest of season for me. Monitor; his status after the bye.
#JetUp #Skol

Jordyn Tyson (hamstring, IR) will not practice this week, per Kellen Moore. WR55 rest of season for me; hold him in an IR spot.

Tyquan Thornton went on IR with a dislocated ankle, and Andy Reid expects him back for the playoffs. Drop him in redraft.
#Saints #ChiefsKingdom

Every item from Monday is on the Pass, with Wednesday's practice reports up next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Tuesday's waiver run and the trade calls, and repost this for your league.
